test.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_decision_sealing.py tests/test_forward_session_runner.py; ruff check src/financial_brain/forward_edge/signal_seal.py src/financial_brain/forward_edge/session_runner.py tests/test_decision_sealing.py

implemented: Every newly generated runner decision and abstention is written with a seal timestamp before risk evaluation and paper execution.
Input proof hashes the strategy/run configuration, preflight receipt, feed-health snapshot, and every source event available by the decision clock.
Events arriving after the decision clock are excluded; direct sealing rejects future inputs.
The durable journal stores a canonical input-manifest digest and content hash of the signal; abstentions carry an explicit reason.
